headline: Government Cuts Ticket Prices by Up to 50 Percent Because of Expensive Fuel
summary: Railway ticket prices in Slovakia will fall by up to 50% from 1 October 2026 for second-class travel, for 30 days. Authorities are also considering lower bus and urban transport fares.
why: The measure is a government response to rising petrol and diesel prices, aimed at cushioning household transport costs.
